records.source_title: About LAPP (LAPP Vietnam)
records.excerpt: The company's portfolio includes standard and highly flexible cables, industrial connectors and screw technology, customised system solutions, automation technology and robotics solutions for the intelligent factory of the future, as well as technical accessories. LAPP's core market is the industrial machinery and plant engineering sector. Other key markets are in the food industry, logistics, as well as the energy and the mobility sector.
records.population: LAPP Group
records.does_not_establish: It lists industrial sectors served and says nothing about sales to private individuals.

records.source_title: About LAPP (LAPP Vietnam)
records.excerpt: The company was founded in 1959 and is still fully family-owned today. In the 2025 fiscal year, it generated a consolidated sales of EUR 1.93 billion. LAPP employs around 5,700 people worldwide, manufactures at 27 international locations and is active in a total of over 80 countries worldwide.
records.population: LAPP Group
records.does_not_establish: Group size and footprint do not show whether any revenue comes from consumers.

records.source_title: Asia strong, Europe slow: LAPP offsets previous year's decline (LAPP Group press release, LAPP Finland site)
records.excerpt: Stuttgart, February 11, 2026 – LAPP Group achieves sales of EUR 1.93 billion in fiscal year 2025 (October 1, 2024 – September 30, 2025). Driven by growth in Asia and America, the Stuttgart-based family company thus offsets last year's decline in sales and grows by around six percent.
records.population: LAPP Group
records.does_not_establish: It does not break out revenue by customer type or say whether any of it came from private buyers.

records.source_title: Asia strong, Europe slow: LAPP offsets previous year's decline (LAPP Group press release, LAPP Finland site)
records.excerpt: One bright spot in Europe: The promising harnessing business, namely the sale of engineering services and customised assembly solutions, is showing positive signs.

records.source_title: Umfrage: Die Wallbox zuhause bleibt Ladeort Nummer eins (Elektroauto-News)
records.excerpt: Für E-Autofahrer:innen in Deutschland bleibt das Laden an der heimischen Wallbox der Normalfall. Laut einer repräsentativen Umfrage, die Civey im Auftrag von Eon durchgeführt hat, laden 63 Prozent ihr Auto am häufigsten zuhause.
records.population: EV drivers in Germany (Civey survey for E.ON)
records.does_not_establish: Charging at home does not show that drivers will buy cables or chargers from a cable maker rather than with the car or wallbox.

records.source_title: Bilanz 2025: Elektroauto-Neuzulassungen auf Rekordhoch (electrive)
records.excerpt: Mit 545.142 Neuzulassungen haben Elektroautos im vergangenen Jahr in Deutschland ein Rekordjahr erreicht. Nach dem Rückgang 2024 legten die Elektro-Pkw damit wie erwartet deutlich zu. Es kamen so viele Stromer wie nie zuvor auf deutsche Straßen.
records.population: New battery-electric car registrations
records.does_not_establish: New-car registrations do not measure the aftermarket for separately bought charging cables.

records.source_title: Steckertypen und Ladekabel: Was passt für Ihr Elektroauto? (ADAC)
records.excerpt: Wichtig ist, dass ein solches Mode-2-Kabel zumindest einen Temperatursensor verbaut hat, damit bei einer Überhitzung der Steckdose automatisch abgeschaltet wird. Das Laden damit sollte aber nur im Ausnahmefall und dann mit reduzierter Ladeleistung erfolgen.
records.population: EV drivers using household sockets
records.does_not_establish: Advice to use Mode 2 only occasionally does not show how often drivers actually buy or use such devices.

records.source_title: WAGO mit Umsatzplus im Jubiläumsjahr (WAGO press release)
records.excerpt: Eine besondere Entwicklung im Jubiläumsjahr 2026 ist die Markteinführung von WAGO Home Automation. Mit diesem neuen Portfolio an Unterputz-Funkmodulen für die smarte Steuerung von beispielsweise Beleuchtung, Jalousien und Steckdosen steigt das Familienunternehmen in den Smart-Home-Markt ein.
records.population: WAGO, a German connection-technology maker, entering smart home
